items.stem: A page is crawled by Google but is not appearing in search results. Which tool shows why?

options.text: The URL Inspection tool in Search Console
options.rationale: Correct: URL Inspection reports the page's index status and reasons.
Analytics shows traffic, not index status.
Firewall logs are unrelated to indexing.

items.explanation: Correct: The URL Inspection tool in Search Console.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which TWO on-page changes can improve a page's search performance? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Write a clear, relevant title and meta description
options.rationale: Correct: descriptive titles/descriptions improve relevance and click-through.

options.text: Add helpful internal links to the page
options.rationale: Correct: internal links help discovery and signal importance.

options.text: Repeat the keyword dozens of times (keyword stuffing)
options.rationale: Stuffing degrades quality and can hurt rankings.

options.text: Block the page with noindex to rank it faster
options.rationale: noindex removes the page from search entirely.

items.explanation: Correct: Write a clear, relevant title and meta description, Add helpful internal links to the page.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: In the Search Console Performance report, what does a high number of impressions with a low CTR suggest?

options.text: The page ranks/shows but the title or snippet is not compelling enough to earn clicks
options.rationale: Correct: many impressions with few clicks points to a weak title/snippet or position.

options.text: The page is not indexed at all
options.rationale: Impressions mean it is showing in results, so it is indexed.

options.text: The site is blocked by robots.txt
options.rationale: A blocked page would not accumulate impressions.
CTR is not a direct measure of Core Web Vitals.

items.explanation: Correct: The page ranks/shows but the title or snippet is not compelling enough to earn clicks.
